_doc: Island conversations allowed to stay without clips (validate-dialogue-voices). The list only shrinks: an entry that is voiced or gone fails until it is deleted. Role conversations are built at runtime from `LF-NpcRole_<role>_*` strings (LF_Roles.BuildDialogue) and cannot carry an event yet: voicing them means authoring each role as a core dialogue spec a pack patches (the fuel clerk and shopkeeper pattern) and making LF_Roles play it.

unvoiced.role:fence: Vince at the fence yard: role conversation, text only
unvoiced.role:mechanic: garage and car lot mechanics: role conversation, text only
unvoiced.role:medic: clinic doctor: role conversation, text only
unvoiced.role:police: station desk officer: role conversation, text only
unvoiced.role:store_clerk: general store, bakery, butcher, hardware, farm supply, timber and gun counter clerks: role conversation, text only
unvoiced.role:teller: bank teller: role conversation, text only
unvoiced.role:townsfolk: town civilians: role conversation, text only
